updates.html: PR10893 is a dependent Draft follow-up to PR10705: it closes the cached-reader compatibility gap, proves successful protected-file overwrite through real I/O and aligns action labels. R4 below retains its earlier characterization and proposal. Current source/browser proof is linked here; neither candidate nor Paper is production acceptance.

scripts/build_confluence_screener.py reads site/factordata/tech_confluence.json and renders the public page plus its protected payload. PR10705 supplies the existing source qualification and full artifact receipt. PR10893 @f51b60de preserves those rules and adds one PAYLOAD_SCHEMA constant, passed to both available/unavailable template contexts and protected JSON. Only this Confluence asset advances to tier_payload.v2. Invalid required input still yields unavailable, null counts and empty rows. No new loader or source owner.

The existing MDXAuth/controller and protected endpoint remain the owners. Confluence now emits tier_payload.v2: the frozen old v1 reader rejects it, and the current reader rejects prior v1 responses. Matching v2 still requires the full source receipt, expected IDs, counts, unique tickers and existing authorization/lifecycle checks before any replacement. The full artifact hash already binds the recipe; add no second recipe identity. Version rejection uses the existing access check; a source-generation mismatch uses Reload latest page. This fence blocks later incompatible hydration, not names already painted by an old page.

Open Mastermind / 打开 Mastermind follows existing cta_url; it does not register an alert. Unavailable-source Reload page / 重新加载页面 calls existing location.reload(), retaining the document URL/query/hash. It does not start a source refresh or guarantee newer data. These labels now agree in source and Paper. Keep native How this shortlist works / 信号组合说明, 44px-or-larger targets, focus and locale continuity. Immediate disclosure; any optional chevron/opacity motion is ≤120ms and absent under reduced motion. No build-time loading shimmer.

Final reviewed source: 82 page tests and 14 browser workflows in 14 fresh contexts, zero page errors; four native EN390/ZH320 action-card crops inspected. Nine seeded cases call actual render() and real public/protected writers, restoring the shim cache after each temporary-root test. They prove successful overwrite, not crash-atomic publication. Browser cases use actual old/new templates with synthetic source and controlled auth/HTTP; they do not browse the saved production-input pair. That pair separately conserves the parent except for protocol fields and matches the actual protected producer. An empty verifier filter exits 2, never a passing empty run.

R3: 272-0 unavailable EN; 274-0 unavailable ZH; 276-0 EN320 with method open; 278-0 qualified zero with test source clock 2026-07-19T04:00:00Z, not a live snapshot. Current source: PR10893 @f51b60de on PR10705 @dce11e42; nine text/source artifacts and four capture blobs are read back exactly. Existing R2 anatomy, retired controls and complete R4 subtree 2I3-0 remain preserved. PR10893 is Draft/unarmed; incumbent #10705 adoption and its calendar proof refusal stay with their owners. Historical 138/39/24 proof remains historical; deployment, entitlement, final Paper/F01/F02 and programme acceptance remain separate.

CONFLUENCE · CURRENT CANDIDATE MAP · 9 NOV 2026
Preserve what the source actually tells us.
PR10705 already implements source qualification, honest counts and protected-response checks. This map reconciles those changes with the accepted Paper states. R4 below preserves its earlier mainline characterization and proposed compatibility contract; it is not current-head execution proof.
01 · Existing source path
scripts/build_confluence_screener.py reads site/factordata/tech_confluence.json and renders the public template plus a separate protected payload. At PR10705 @dce11e42, _source_receipt() qualifies one artifact and supplies source_status/source_generation to both projections. Missing, unreadable, non-object or invalid required input now yields unavailable, null counts and empty rows. The false-zero behavior remains on the compared mainline, but this candidate already repairs it. Reuse this implementation.
02 · One availability branch
Use the existing qualification branch. Required source clock, coverage, split date, legs, IDs, active ticker lists and numeric evidence must pass _source_receipt(). Invalid required input means unavailable, not zero. A qualified artifact with combos.long=[] means available with zero eligible combinations. Otherwise _eligible_long_combos() selects active rows with both historical rates, orders by rank_score and supplies at most three cards. Preserve the same receipt and selection rule in both public and protected projections; add no loader, availability service or second selection owner.
03 · Missingness & clocks
A qualified receipt requires timezone-aware generated_utc. Missing, date-only or invalid source time makes the source unavailable and its matching count unknown. source_built is the full source-generation time; it is not a market observation clock. The template explicitly says market observation time is not supplied. The separate page generated_utc must never substitute for missing source time. Required period fire/month counts qualify the source; absent optional history, baselines, edges or consistency remain unknown. Preserve legitimate supplied zero/false without inventing a negative historical conclusion.
04 · Counts, order & scope
n_active_total counts all eligible active combinations before the top-three cap. combos|length counts displayed cards, from zero to three; universe_n is separate source coverage. Current candidate headings and Showing N of M copy distinguish those scopes. Keep rank_score order and stable ties, combo_id, is_free and active_count. Zero means this qualified source contains no active combinations with readings for both periods. It does not mean all market signals are inactive. Do not fabricate rows, dates, ranks, legs or samples.
05 · Simpler primary controls
Eight R2 anatomy references now omit active-looking filter bars. All eight bars and four mobile filter sheets retain their original IDs on p-4-0. Current source has no filter implementation, so add none to this three-card main list. A future study would filter only supplied published combinations; define Weekly precisely and require a known consistency value. Never renumber ranks or make the first visible paid card free. A later hide/show implementation must preserve DOM identity for the incumbent one-time hydrator.
06 · Protected access stays separate
The existing MDXAuth/controller and protected endpoint remain the owners. Current candidate validates the complete response against source_generation, expected IDs, counts and unique tickers before applying replacements; account, expiry and lifecycle guards invalidate stale work. The full artifact hash already binds recipe content and is not entitlement. Preserve public evidence and protected failure recovery. R4 identifies a remaining gap: the candidate still emits tier_payload.v1, so cached old pages can ignore the new receipt and accept it. Pair a protocol discriminator that the old reader rejects with the existing producer/new consumer; do not add a second recipe-key lifecycle. The producer's empty protected overwrite still needs actual render proof.
07 · Actions, method & motion
Open Mastermind / 打开 Mastermind follows the existing cta_url and registers no alert. Paper retains this destination label; current candidate still says Get notified when setups fire on its empty-state link, so source-copy alignment remains owed. Its public-unavailable Check again button only calls location.reload(): describe it as a page reload, not a source refresh, miner run or subscription. Keep native How this shortlist works / 信号组合说明, whole-target sizing, focus and locale continuity. Immediate expansion; optional chevron/opacity ≤120ms, absent under reduced motion. No build-time loading shimmer.
08 · Focused implementation proof
Current page tests already distinguish qualified zero from unavailable input, reject malformed source clocks/structure and bind both projections to exact artifact content. Historical 138 tests, 39 browser cases and 24 captures belong to the older accepted source; they were not rerun on dce11e42. The test named for empty overwrite exercises only build_premium_payload(None), not disk I/O. Add a seeded old protected file and actual render(tmp_path) proof before claiming overwrite behavior. Retain rank/free/gated, public ticker exclusion, complete response, account/expiry/focus and old/new consumer checks. No miner, entitlement or release change.
09 · Canvas map & source pin
R3: 272-0 unavailable EN; 274-0 unavailable ZH; 276-0 320px with method open; 278-0 qualified zero using the existing test fixture's source clock 2026-07-19T04:00:00Z. Its source time is illustrative test input, not a live snapshot. 278 no longer pairs proven zero with an unqualified receipt. Existing R2 anatomy, retired controls on p-4-0 and R4 child 2I3-0 remain preserved. Current comparison: Macro PR10705 @dce11e42c79da7bf45bdda930b473d3f6a97e54e; builder f6a34870, template 64864e62, tests 34c7fe29. Earlier mainline pin 338a1085 remains historical. Source candidate is unmerged; current delivery, final Paper/programme and production acceptance stay separate.

R4 · CONTROLS + SNAPSHOT IDENTITY · 2026-11-09
Keep the evidence and names together.
Extends the R3 contract above. Nine isolated cases reproduce current hydration behavior; the production guard is still to be built.
01 · REPRODUCED SOURCE GAP
An ordinal ID is not a recipe identity.
The miner assigns L000n by selected-list position. The current hydrator joins only on combo_id, ignores built and announces success for empty, unmatched or partial arrays. A different snapshot can reuse the same ID and attach its names to the wrong public recipe. A malformed positive-count list can even become “no matches.”
02 · ONE EXISTING BUILDER
Bind both projections before rendering.
In scripts/build_confluence_screener.py, compute one artifact_sha256 from canonical raw JSON and a recipe_key from resolved signal ID, timeframe, kind, direction and applicable event windows. Reuse these in build_context and build_premium_payload. Preserve combo_id, rank, is_free and active_count. Public metadata contains no protected names. Full artifact built remains distinct from page-render time and the date-only display.
03 · ONE EXISTING HYDRATOR
Validate everything before replacing anything.
Require schema, fingerprint, full built, the exact expected protected-row set and each recipe_key to match. Require unique valid tickers and counts equal to the public card and payload list. Prepare all replacements first; mark hydrated only after complete application. Missing, extra, duplicate or malformed rows retain the public cards and existing protected-unavailable recovery. Zero expected protected rows need no paid-success announcement.
04 · COMPATIBILITY IS PART OF THE FIX
Reject unbound versions during rollout.
A new schema for this protected asset must be rejected by cached tier_payload.v1 code; the new consumer must also reject legacy unbound responses. Additive fields alone cannot fix cached old clients. Keep the existing endpoint, MDXAuth, inFlight and refresh path. Keep the missing-source empty overwrite; do not turn that empty file into successful hydration.
05 · CONTROL CONTRACT
Open the app; disclose the method locally.
All R2 app links say Open Mastermind / 打开 Mastermind and follow the existing cta_url. They do not start a trial, build a combination or grant access. Main controls are 48px; card links are at least 44px. The whole method row is a native details/summary target, with focus and expanded state; no fetch. Use the existing ≤120ms disclosure treatment and instant reduced-motion state.
06 · ACCEPTANCE
Mixed generations must fail before UI changes.
Test matching control, different generation, equal timestamp with changed content, wrong recipe, missing/extra/duplicate row, invalid/duplicate ticker, count disagreement, no protected rows and both old/new schema directions. Test a valid recovery through the current controller. Preserve rank, free status and usable public evidence throughout.
